hero.title: Boiler Service
hero.paragraph: Keep your boiler safe and your warranty valid with a yearly service from a local Gas Safe engineer (No. 574111). We have serviced boilers for Harrow homeowners and landlords since 2007. Fixed price before we start, written record at the end.

serviceDetails.title: Why service your boiler every year?
paras: A yearly service finds small faults before they turn into a breakdown on the coldest day of the year. A clean boiler burns gas more efficiently, so less of your money goes up the flue. Most boiler makers also ask for a yearly service to keep your warranty valid.
A service also checks your boiler is safe. Our engineer tests for carbon monoxide on every visit, a gas you cannot see or smell.
serviceDetails.alt: Gas Safe engineer servicing a boiler in Harrow

serviceDetails.title: What does a boiler service include?
paras: Every service follows the same full check, whatever the make of boiler:
list: Check the casing, seals and fittings
Clean the burner, heat exchanger and main parts
Check the flue and run a flue gas test
Clear the condensate trap and check the pipe
Test controls, thermostat and safety devices
Check system pressure and the expansion vessel
Give you a written service record
serviceDetails.alt: Flue gas test during a boiler service in Harrow

serviceDetails.title: Boiler service and gas safety certificate for Harrow landlords
paras: Harrow has a large number of rented homes, and we already work with letting agents across Harrow, Pinner, Stanmore and Northolt. Every rented home needs a gas safety certificate (CP12) each year by law.

We can service the boiler and carry out the CP12 check on the same visit, so your tenants only let us in once. Send us your tenant's contact details and our team books the visit around them. A CP12 on its own costs £80 to £120, and you get a digital certificate within 24 hours.
serviceDetails.alt: Landlord in Harrow receiving a gas safety certificate

serviceDetails.title: Servicing older boilers in Harrow homes
paras: Many homes in Harrow and Pinner still run older boilers, often tucked in kitchen cupboards or lofts. Older boilers need a service just as much as new ones, and often more, as worn parts and old seals are more likely to fail.
If our engineer finds your boiler is near the end of its life, we tell you honestly, and explain whether a repair or a new boiler makes more sense.
serviceDetails.alt: Older boiler in a Harrow home ready for a service

serviceDetails.title: How much is a boiler service in Harrow?
paras: We give you a fixed price before any work starts, with no hidden extras. Call 07800 657141 or send your boiler make on WhatsApp for an exact price. If we find a fault, we explain it and give you a fixed price to repair before doing any extra work.
serviceDetails.alt: Engineer explaining boiler service results in Harrow

serviceDetails.title: When is the best time to book?
paras: Any time is fine, but booking before the cold weather sets in means any fault is found while you can still live without heat for a day. Once you are booked, we can remind you when your next service is due, so you never miss a year and your warranty stays valid.
serviceDetails.alt: Booking a boiler service before winter in Harrow

faqSection.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqSection.subtitle: Still unsure? Call or WhatsApp us and we will help.

faqs.q: How much is a boiler service in Harrow?
faqs.a: We give a fixed price before any work starts. Call 07800 657141 or send your boiler make on WhatsApp for an exact price.

faqs.q: How long does a boiler service take?
faqs.a: Most services take under an hour. Older or very dirty boilers can take a little longer.

faqs.q: What does a boiler service include?
faqs.a: A full check and clean of the main parts, gas pressure and flow tests, a flue gas test, checks on controls and safety devices, and a written record.

faqs.q: How often should I service my boiler?
faqs.a: Once every 12 months. Most makers ask for a yearly service to keep the warranty valid.

faqs.q: Can you do a CP12 at the same time?
faqs.a: Yes. We can service the boiler and do the landlord gas safety check on one visit.

faqs.q: Do you work with letting agents in Harrow?
faqs.a: Yes. We already work with letting agents across Harrow and nearby areas, and can book directly with your tenants.

faqs.q: Which boiler brands do you service?
faqs.a: All major gas boiler brands, including Worcester Bosch, Vaillant, Ideal and Baxi.

faqs.q: Do you cover Pinner and Stanmore?
faqs.a: Yes. We cover Harrow, Pinner, Stanmore, Edgware, Northolt, Ruislip and Wembley.

faqs.q: What happens if you find a fault?
faqs.a: We explain the fault, give you a fixed price to repair, and only go ahead with your OK.
Yes. AR Heating is Gas Safe registered, No. 574111. You can check our number on the official Gas Safe Register.
